# {{ site.data.resume.basics.name }}

> {{ site.data.resume.basics.label }}. {{ site.data.resume.basics.summary }}

Personal academic website of {{ site.data.resume.basics.name }}. The pages below are plain HTML; the CV is also available as structured data.

## Pages

- [About]({{ site.url }}/): research focus, methods and contact.
- [CV]({{ site.url }}/cv/): education, positions, research grants, teaching, supervision, conferences and skills.
- [Publications]({{ site.url }}/publications/): peer-reviewed journal articles with DOIs, sortable by year or citations.
- [Projects]({{ site.url }}/projects/): funded research grants and long-term research projects.

## Machine-readable

- [CV as JSON Resume]({{ site.url }}/assets/json/resume.json): the single source of truth for the CV page.
- [CV as PDF]({{ site.url }}/assets/pdf/CV_Wuensch.pdf): the same content as a downloadable document.
- [Sitemap]({{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml)
